principles: Node는 공통 계약으로 관리하고, 산출물은 Artifact Schema로 검증한다.
Event Ledger는 원본 기록이고, Graph/Index는 파생 뷰다.
사용자 승인 없는 공식 등록/PASS/DONE은 금지한다.
consolidated_in_v0_4_3: scripts/validate_artifacts.py: merged validate_generated_artifacts.py and validate_tool_contracts.py into one glob-based validator (run twice per README: once before run_case.py, once after)

bugfix found during consolidation: old validate_artifacts.py hardcoded only 1 of 6 data/sample/tool_contracts/*.json fixtures (TOOL-S2P-ANALYZER.json); the other 5 (ANNOTATION-PARSER, CONSTRAINT-CHECKER, REPORT-DATA-BUILDER, SIMPLE-EVALUATOR, SIMPLE-RAG-RETRIEVER) were never schema-checked. Glob pattern now covers all 6.
